review_notes: Reviewed all 61 lines of the target and inspected the definitions of movingCompleteRootCuts and movingPrimeRootCuts that determine the nested unions used in the proof. The proposed subset-composition replacement is based on those definitions; I have not claimed it was compiled.

findings.excerpt:
have hrootA : movingTopRootCuts value hvalue childBound pivotBound T hf XR ⊆ roots := by
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)
findings.problem: The proof manually introduces an element and nests two membership constructors to establish inclusion through two nested unions. This obscures the set-inclusion structure of the argument.
findings.proposed_change: Replace lines 36–38 with `have hrootA : movingTopRootCuts value hvalue childBound pivotBound T hf XR ⊆ roots := Finset.subset_union_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left`.
findings.benefit: This states the same two inclusions directly and composes them, avoiding element-level membership bookkeeping. The two subset lemmas correspond transparently to the two union layers in the definitions, so the mathematical idea is at least as easy to follow.
